trace_context: One quality process; phase/T1 windows use CLOCK_MONOTONIC. Numeric samples prove execution only at sampled instants. Per-graph complete team membership is unobserved.

effective_clock.scope: Entire low-rate APERF/MPERF/TSC observation over the combined Japanese quality prefill and 64 decode calls, including short observer boundaries. CPU-wide, selected cores. Active-time weighted across cores.
effective_clock.method: Each interval: TSC reference GHz = TSC cycles / perf running nanoseconds. Estimated active ns = MPERF / TSC reference GHz. Combined MHz = 1000 * sum(APERF) / sum(active ns).
